items.title: Typing label uses the peer's first name
items.precondition: A peer with a multi-word display name is typing.
steps: Open a conversation or inbox where the peer is typing.
items.expected: The label reads the first name followed by 'is typing', for example 'Zarina is typing'.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: user confirmed the local server behavior after the change.

items.title: Dark themed typing indicator remains readable
items.precondition: A custom conversation theme is active in Messages dark mode.
steps: Have the peer type in the themed conversation.
Inspect the typing row above the composer.
items.expected: The label and dots are on the conversation background, with no mismatched white strip.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: user confirmed the local server behavior after the change.
items.notes: Uses the existing chat background and foreground variables.

items.title: Messages cards have no shadow
items.precondition: Messages inbox and an open conversation are available.
items.expected: Neither Messages surface has a shadow at rest or on hover.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: user confirmed the local server behavior after the change.
items.notes: The override is scoped to Messages cards only.

items.title: Frontend typecheck
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck passed after the final UI change.

items.title: Shared socket survives same-user component cleanup
items.precondition: Two authenticated participants and an auth-state refresh test harness.
steps: Open a shared conversation in two sessions.
Refresh the authenticated state for one viewer without signing out.
Have the peer type and confirm the viewer continues to receive the typing update.
items.expected: The shared socket stays connected through same-user cleanup; sign-out still disconnects it.
items.evidence: Not exercised in a two-account refresh session during this visual-fix run.
items.notes: The existing no-user branch continues to disconnect the socket; frontend typecheck passed with this edit present.
items.waiver: 2026-08-20: user explicitly directed inclusion of this pre-existing socket lifecycle change in the commit; two-account refresh acceptance is waived for this visual-fix session.
